items.description: Advised early-stage AI and healthcare ventures on go-to-market strategy and financial modeling.

Integrated Instagram and WhatsApp Business APIs into the HyperConnect platform, overseeing technical implementations and enhancing cross-functional collaboration to deliver seamless, real-time customer-facing communication solutions for global enterprise clients.

Utilized behavioral data analytics to drive critical User Experience improvements, reducing page load times by 75% and demonstrating a commitment to technical optimization and high-performance, user-centric frontend engineering standards.

Modernized a legacy C#/.NET monolith architecture to significantly improve system performance, reducing critical incidents by 50% and increasing system throughput by 30% to align with long-term scalability goals.

Translated ambiguous product requirements into precise technical specifications for Flutter-based mobile applications, enhancing product-market fit through robust stakeholder management and collaboration with senior engineering and product leadership.

Conducted time series analysis for IoT-based HVAC system automation, evaluating occupancy prediction models using Linear Discriminant Analysis and Dempster Schafer Evidence Theory to achieve a high accuracy of 99.98%.

Facilitated peer-based research by training others in machine learning and data analysis techniques for upcoming publications, fostering a collaborative environment for advanced analytical model development and performance validation.
